scope: First expansion batch; localization crops, not certified contour segmentation; no font changes
coordinate_system: Original 1578x2174 pixels; raw x/y/w/h. mirror = horizontal reflection only; positions 1-based when proposed.
confidence_convention: CSV 0.0 for new candidates means not estimated; no calibrated probabilities are asserted.

source.attribution: Imágenes procedentes de los fondos de la Biblioteca Nacional de España
source.rights: Record and JPEG download panel: public domain; CC BY 4.0 or equivalent; attribution BNE; free use without prior authorization. Images are acquired only for ignored local study and not distributed.
source.acquisition: Official JPEG download UI, pages14,16,18,20. Download filenames1–4 correspond to selected pages, not folio numbers. SHA256 matches previously registered originals.
source.folio_mapping: Retained working mapping:14=1r;16=2r;18=3r;20=4r; no new independent paleographic certification.

deferred.h: Nessuna occorrenza sufficientemente isolabile selezionata nel batch; proseguire su altri contesti.
deferred.v: Separazione moderna u/v da trattare come decisione di normalizzazione, senza inferirla automaticamente dalla forma.
deferred.j k w x y: Ricerca mirata ancora da svolgere; nessuna assenza dal manoscritto viene affermata.
